card.name: Space before a three-digit dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or first digit) right before a dose amount like 100, 156, 200 or 675, in dosing instructions for injectable drugs. It also fires on the first digit of such numbers.

modes.label: Space before dose
modes.description: The blank space after 'dose of', 'is' or 'or' just before a three-digit mg amount.

modes.label: First digit of dose
modes.description: The leading digit of a three-digit amount such as 100 or 156.
modes.example: The recommended dosage is <<1>>00 mg. Pediatric Patients

modes.label: Space after drug name
modes.description: The space after an injectable product name, before its strength.
